assessment_snapshot.intro: Recon identifies a small Java Maven project with a possible desktop UI, but the precise MVC boundary cannot be established without source analysis:
bullets: Approximately 1,309 LOC in one source module under src/main/java/com/mycompany/pdf4um, with image resources under com/mycompany/img
Desktop GUI presence is plausible from Main.java and bundled UI icon assets, but remains unconfirmed
No target Java or framework version is specified; the request calls for an MVC refactor in the existing workspace

proposed_outcome: Clarify the intended MVC scope and any framework or UI constraints, then refactor the existing Java application in place while preserving observable behavior and validating with relevant tests and a build.
